status.description: done: every criterion is done. more: a continuation can finish the remaining work without a decision. question: an answer is needed and the work has stopped. blocked: the work cannot go on.

summary.description: Brief: what was done, what was checked, what was not checked; for blocked, what is in the way.

evidence.description: Brief: file:line, a command with its result, or the path of a preview.

text.description: The question and why the work cannot go on without the answer.

options.description: The options, the recommended one first; empty when there are none.

changedFiles.description: Paths from the repository root that the package created, changed or deleted.

result.description: One line of outcome. For a check prevented solely by a confirmed writer sandbox restriction, use 'sandbox: <observed error>' and keep the actual exit code or null. The runner verifies an otherwise done criterion outside the sandbox.
